directAnswer: DLSS improves image quality in real-time as long as it is enabled in a game. The effect lasts throughout gameplay until the feature is disabled or the game is closed.
summary: DLSS provides continuous enhancement of image quality while active, adapting dynamically to performance and resolution settings.

sections.heading: Understanding DLSS
sections.body: DLSS (Deep Learning Super Sampling) uses AI to upscale lower resolution images, providing better performance and image quality. The improvements are noticeable during gameplay, but the effectiveness can vary based on the game's implementation.

sections.heading: Enabling DLSS
sections.body: To enable DLSS, navigate to the graphics settings in your game. Look for the DLSS option and select your preferred mode (Quality, Balanced, Performance). Note that the exact menu path may differ by game.

sections.heading: Monitoring Performance
sections.body: Keep an eye on performance metrics while using DLSS. If you notice a drop in frame rates or visual artifacts, consider adjusting the DLSS settings or resolution.

steps.title: Open Game Settings
steps.detail: Access the graphics settings menu within your game.

steps.title: Locate DLSS Option
steps.detail: Find the DLSS setting, which may be under advanced graphics options.

steps.title: Select DLSS Mode
steps.detail: Choose from available DLSS modes: Quality, Balanced, or Performance.

steps.title: Apply Changes
steps.detail: Save your settings and return to gameplay to experience the improvements.

faqs.question: Does DLSS work with all games?
faqs.answer: No, DLSS is only supported in games that have implemented the technology. Check the game's specifications for compatibility.

faqs.question: Can I switch DLSS modes mid-game?
faqs.answer: Yes, most games allow you to change DLSS settings during gameplay, but it may require a brief pause to apply changes.

faqs.question: Will DLSS affect my system performance?
faqs.answer: DLSS is designed to improve performance by allowing higher frame rates while maintaining image quality, but results can vary depending on your hardware.

caveats: The effectiveness of DLSS can vary depending on the game and its graphical settings.
Some users may experience visual artifacts or performance issues with certain DLSS modes.
